run_moolib_group_test: run the test_group.py script to verify moolib Group membership sync across 4 clients
create_moolib_rpc_client: create an Rpc instance with set_name, set_timeout, define, and connect to a broker address
create_moolib_broker: create a Broker from an Rpc instance and call listen on a local address
create_moolib_group: create a Group from an Rpc instance with set_timeout and set_sort_order for member ordering
send_async_rpc_message: send an async RPC message to another client using rpc.async_ with a target name and method
